title: Missing a Connecting Flight
summaryZh: 作者因班機延誤錯過轉機，從此不再訂時間太短的轉機行程。

sentences.text: I used to think a two hour layover was plenty of time to catch a connecting flight.
sentences.zh: 我以前總覺得兩小時的轉機時間，趕下一班飛機綽綽有餘。
sentences.note: used to 連讀成 /ˈjus.tə/，d 消失；plenty 的 nt 只留 /n/，連 of 成 /ˈplɛ.ni.əv/。

sentences.text: Then I got stuck on a runway in Chicago for ninety minutes with the engines shut off.
sentences.zh: 結果我在芝加哥的跑道上卡了九十分鐘，引擎還關著。
sentences.note: got stuck 的 t 完全不釋放，只留一個停頓；shut off 連讀成 /ʃʌ.ˈɾɔf/。

sentences.text: By the time we pulled up to the gate, my connection to Lisbon was already boarding.
sentences.zh: 等我們滑到登機門的時候，我飛里斯本的那班已經在登機了。

sentences.text: I ran through the terminal with my bag banging against my leg the whole way.
sentences.zh: 我一路衝過航廈，包包整路打在我腿上。

sentences.text: I made it to the gate about four minutes after they closed the door.
sentences.zh: 我趕到登機門的時候，他們關艙門大概已經四分鐘了。
sentences.note: made it 連成 /ˈmeɪ.ɾɪt/，d 在母音間變閃音；to 弱讀成 /tə/。

sentences.text: The agent looked at me, shook her head, and told me the plane was pushing back.
sentences.zh: 地勤看了我一眼，搖搖頭，說飛機已經在後推了。

sentences.text: I stood there for a second, not sure whether to argue or just sit down and give up.
sentences.zh: 我在那裡站了幾秒，不知道該爭取一下，還是乾脆坐下放棄。
sentences.note: sit down 的 t 變成喉塞音 /sɪʔ.daʊn/；whether to 的 to 弱讀成 /tə/。

sentences.text: What surprised me was how calmly she started fixing it before I even asked her to.
sentences.zh: 讓我意外的是，我都還沒開口，她就很冷靜地開始幫我處理。

sentences.text: She put me on a flight through Madrid that got in six hours later than planned.
sentences.zh: 她幫我改到經馬德里的班機，比原訂時間晚六小時抵達。
sentences.note: put me 的 t 不爆破；got in 連成 /ˈɡɑ.ɾɪn/，t 變閃音。

sentences.text: Then she handed me a voucher for dinner and pointed me toward the right terminal.
sentences.zh: 然後她給了我一張晚餐券，指了指我該去的那個航廈。

sentences.text: I ended up eating a bad sandwich and sleeping on a bench next to a family of five.
sentences.zh: 我最後吃了個難吃的三明治，睡在一家五口旁邊的長椅上。

sentences.text: But I got where I was going, and my bag turned up the next morning on its own.
sentences.zh: 但我還是到了目的地，而且我的行李隔天早上自己出現了。

sentences.text: Now I never book a layover under three hours, no matter how much cheaper it looks.
sentences.zh: 現在不管看起來便宜多少，我都不訂三小時以內的轉機。
sentences.note: matter 的 t 在兩個母音之間變閃音 /ˈmæ.ɾɚ/；book a 連成 /ˈbʊ.kə/。

sentences.text: The extra hour costs almost nothing compared to a night on an airport bench.
sentences.zh: 跟在機場長椅上睡一晚比起來，多留一小時幾乎沒什麼成本。

questions.q: Why did the writer miss the flight?
options: The first plane was stuck on the runway
He went to the wrong terminal

questions.q: What did the gate agent do?
options: Rebooked him on a flight through Madrid
Told him to buy a new ticket

questions.q: What does the writer do differently now?
options: He books layovers of at least three hours
